lines.t:
A state in which an <c:ffff00>attack<c> reaches the {{opponent}} but
doesn't land cleanly, failing to deliver its normal
{{effect}}.

The <c:ffff00>{{damage}}<c> dealt drops and, in addition, <c:ffff00>negative<c>
<c:ffff00>statuses<c> and other effects are not applied.

The lower the <c:ffff00>{{success_power}}<c> of the attack, the
more likely it is to occur.
